note: TEST-ONLY secrets. Shared vectors for profile-service (verifier) and account-service (signer) of GET /api/internal/applications/:applicationId/refund-state; byte-identical in both repos, SHA-256 pinned in each suite. Same p5-svc-sig/1 canonicalization as p5-service-signing.v1.json (first vector reproduces that file's first vector); audience profile-service, idem and body empty (GET, no Idempotency-Key, no body). The operation is bound by method + exact target path, which the verifier allow-lists.
